title: win10xbox machine.json
description: Configuration of the virtual PC stored in the machine folder root. Every section is optional; missing fields take the Windows 10 22H2 defaults. Unknown top-level keys are tolerated (other modules may add sections); unknown keys inside the sections below are rejected to catch typos.

windows.description: OS version the guest sees (PEB, KUSER_SHARED_DATA, registry CurrentVersion).

identity.description: Computer and user identity. user_name also names the guest profile directory C:\Users\<user_name>.

dll_overrides.description: Per-DLL source, like Wine's WINEDLLOVERRIDES. Keys are module base names (case-insensitive, with or without .dll) or "*" for every other module (default native,builtin). Values: native, builtin, native,builtin (native first, fall back to builtin), builtin,native, or disabled (the file does not exist for the guest; the empty string means the same). ntdll, kernelbase and kernel32 are always builtin and their entries are ignored with a warning.

drives.description: Guest drive letter to host directory. Host paths are absolute, or relative to the machine folder. C: defaults to the machine folder itself (".").

offset_ms.description: Added to the host wall clock, in milliseconds.

syscall_overrides.description: Per-syscall dispatcher policy override: syscall name to passthrough, translate, emulate or todo.
